verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.speechmatics.com (HTTP 200, structured index of developer docs), and a second llms.txt on www.speechmatics.com indexes product features. Doc pages are also served as markdown (.md URLs such as the realtime websocket API reference and diarization pages), giving agents clean, machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-usage guidance, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
